name: PAT_ENC_CLAIMS
description: This table stores claim-related information for the patient encounter.

columns.name: PAT_ENC_CSN_ID
columns.description: The unique contact serial number for this contact. This number is unique across all patient encounters in your system. If you use IntraConnect, this is the Unique Contact Identifier (UCI).

columns.name: PAT_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the patient record for this row. This column is frequently used to link to the PATIENT table.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE
columns.description: The date of this contact in calendar format.

columns.name: CM_CT_OWNER_ID
columns.description: The Community ID (CID) of the instance that owns this contact. This is only populated if you use IntraConnect.

columns.name: EXPRESS_CLAIM_TRIGGERED_YN
columns.description: Indicates whether express claims were triggered. "Y" indicates that Express Claims Processing was initiated for the patient encounter. "N" or NULL indicates that Express Claims Processing was not initiated for the patient encounter.

columns.name: EC_TRIGGERED_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: the instant of the most recent attempt to trigger Express Claims

columns.name: EXPR_CLM_NOT_TRGR_RSN_C_NAME
columns.description: the most recent reason that Express Claims were not triggered
entries: Charge in PB charge review workqueue
Level of Service charges not triggered
Charge Capture, Flowsheet, or Immunization charges not triggered

columns.name: NO_TRGR_INVOICE_ID
columns.description: the invoice that was previously created

columns.name: NO_TRGR_UCL_ID
columns.description: the charge that was not ready for claim creation

columns.name: NO_TRGR_WORKQUEUE_ID
columns.description: the workqueue that held the charge

columns.name: NO_TRGR_TAR_ID
columns.description: the charge session that was not ready for claim creation

columns.name: NO_TRGR_ORDER_ID
columns.description: the order that needed charges triggered or that was awaiting transmittal
